name: agentreplay
description: A browser workflow flight recorder for AI agents: record web workflows, compile them into graphs, run agents against them, and surface where they diverge.

scripts.dev: echo "Run 'docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up' or see docs/local-setup.md"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agentreplay/recorder-sdk && npm run build -w @agentreplay/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agentreplay/recorder-sdk && python -m pytest apps/api/tests
